description: Drag a source onto a target: HTML5 drag-and-drop (draggable lists, SortableJS, React DnD) and mouse drags (sliders, canvas, resize handles). Scrolls the source into view; says when no page reaction was detected. Source: from_ref/from_selector or from_x+from_y; target: to_ref/to_selector or to_x+to_y.

from_x.description: Source viewport X in px (with from_y)

steps.description: Native mouseMoved events between press and release; minimum 5

to_x.description: Target viewport X in px (with to_y)

name: drag
